gaps.gap: DeFi depth is near-zero outside a single Morpho rail: lending, DEX liquidity, and yield products that anchor Base/Solana are barely present, leaving room for simple savings/yield apps
gaps.evidence: DefiLlama lists ~31 protocols on World Chain with ~$30.2M chain TVL vs 932 protocols and ~$5,651M TVL on Base; top World Chain entries are Binance CEX ($84M), Morpho Blue ($28.6M), Uniswap (~$1.5M combined).

gaps.gap: No x402 / HTTP-402 machine micropayments standard visible anywhere in the World ecosystem, while that is the fastest-growing app category on Base/Solana
gaps.evidence: Full scrape of world.org/ecosystem returned 494 app listings; none is an x402 pay-per-call API marketplace or agent-payment storefront. Meanwhile x402 crossed 196M transactions / $42M settled by Nov 2026 with ~45% on Base and Visa/Mastercard/Stripe backing.

gaps.gap: Native prediction markets are tiny: the category exists only via US-regulated Kalshi/Polymarket bridges; on-chain prediction TVL is ~0
gaps.evidence: X3X (the only prediction-market protocol listed for World Chain on DefiLlama) shows ~0 TVL; native games (Mantica, Yoso, Canopy, Ground Truth) are small mini apps, not liquidity venues.

gaps.gap: Token/memecoin launchpad economy is absent by design, unlike Base (Clanker) or Solana (pump.fun) — and partially blocked by policy
gaps.evidence: Airdrop/claim apps dominate, but developer playbook lists 'NO token pre-sales' as a rejection trigger; only a ~0-TVL 'Meme Wallet' launchpad appears on DefiLlama.

gaps.gap: Creator-economy / content monetization (Zora/Farcaster-style mints, paid posts, subscriptions) is underdeveloped
gaps.evidence: Among 494 ecosystem listings only marginal apps (Scribstack, Tessera, World Billboard, Post Chain) do creator monetization; no social-token economy exists.

gaps.gap: Simple group-money utilities are missing: no split-the-bill, group savings/ROSCA, escrow or subscription-management apps found
gaps.evidence: Catalog scan found only solo savings (Nest, Cash Vault) and the single 'Coverage, one tap away' insurance app; World's own Morpho blog pitches 'reputation-based lending circles' and 'pay-as-you-go insurance' as unbuilt possibilities.

gaps.gap: Long-tail quality is low: flagship mini apps are run by funded teams while community apps vary, so a polished micro-fee utility can still stand out in a 500+ app store
gaps.evidence: 2026 guide: 'By May 2026, World App's Mini App directory carries more than 250 published applications... the long tail is community-built and varies in quality.'

builder_economics: builder_economics": "Dev Rewards (World Foundation): pilot launched ~April 1, 2025 at $25K/week paid in WLD (=$300K over 3 months) distributed pro-rata by verified-human usage of live Mini Apps (https://world.org/blog/announcements/world-launches-mini-apps-300k-dev-rewards-pilot-inspire-human-first-apps). It was raised to $100K/week from Sept 29–Dec 31, 2025 with clearer usage/impact metrics, alongside stats of 500+ mini apps, 2M+ daily opens and 100M+ WLD transacted in mini apps (https://world.org/blog/announcements/dev-rewards-pilot-increases-to-100k-per-week-as-the-world-ecosystem-surpasses-500-mini-apps). One-time Retro Rewards paid 1M WLD to apps with ≥10,000 verified unique humans by May 16, 2025 (https://world.org/blog/developers/world-dev-summer-build-for-world-network-get-rewarded). STATUS CAUTION (UNVERIFIED): the latest official docs page still describes only the original $300K/3-month pilot and I found no 2026 announcement of the weekly pool's continuation after Dec 31, 2025 — confirm the live program and leaderboard via world.org/rfp before budgeting (https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/more/community-tools-perks, https://world.org/rfp). Grants: rolling Spark Track (idea→working mini app) and Scale Track (grow live apps 10x) mini app grants via world.org/rfp, plus a Foundation Mini App Grants pool of up to 50M WLD (https://world.org/nl-nl/community-grants, https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/more/grants); grants program is open to US builders even where WLD eligibility rules differ (World Dev Summer blog). Incubators: World Build cohorts (FWB) — WB2 winners (Fram3s, Valor, Whole World Catalog) got Buenos Aires retreat + virtual program; World Build 3 (2026) has a $20K 4-day hackathon, Seoul Build Week, 3-month program, SF demo day; alumni raised $15M+ from VCs (https://world.org/blog/announcements/build-once-deploy-anywhere-minikit-2.0-is-live-for-world-developers, https://news.bitcoin.com/world-unveils-new-toolkit-expands-developer-program-with-world-build-3). World One residency: 3 months, $10K/month, up to 5 solo SF builders (https://world.org/one). Builder perks: Alchemy free enterprise tier + $500–2K credits, Cloudflare for Startups, thirdweb trial, Oculus analytics (~10K users routed to early apps) (https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/more/community-tools-perks, https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/ecosystem/ecosystem). Direct monetization: mini apps can charge fees/subscriptions/ads/commissions; payments run peer-to-peer between the user's self-custody wallet and the developer's wallet in USDC or WLD only — app-native tokens are NOT allowed as a payment method; gas is sponsored by World App via paymaster (Pimlico), so users rarely see fees (https://strapi.aurum.law/uploads/World_Mini_Apps_Developer_Legal_Guidelines_2026_d55dbc64a1.pdf, https://www.pimlico.io/case-studies/world-app). MiniKit 2.0 (April 2026) makes web app → mini app conversion ~2 lines (EIP-1193 aligned). Tax: developers owe tax/VAT/GST where resident and where users are."
pitfalls_raw:
pitfalls": [
    "Mandatory review: every mini app must pass TFH review via Developer Portal before public listing; no SLA, and repeat rejections for the same issue slow subsequent reviews (https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/guidelines/policy, https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/more/faq).",
    "Known rejection triggers (developer-reported checklist): chance-based games / RNG-determined prizes, token pre-sales, paid memberships that boost yield, 'official' wording, World logos/branding, NFT purchase buttons, and using 'World' in the app name (https://github.com/ElliotFriedman/harvest-world/blob/main/docs/infra-checklist.md).",
    "App must ship a live World ID integration (IDKit or MiniKit) — you cannot launch as a plain webview app — and must be a final product, not beta/demo (https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/guidelines/policy).",
    "Gambling law: any loop with consideration + chance + prize risks being classified as gaming/gambling; to stay unlicensed, drop staking, remove chance, or make prizes non-transferable/valueless. Prediction-market-like apps sit squarely in this zone; Kalshi works only because it is a CFTC-regulated venue with its own KYC and US focus (https://aurum.law/newsroom/World-Mini-Apps-2026-The-Legal-and-Compliance-Guide-for-Developers, https://world.org/blog/announcements/title-prediction-markets-launch-on-world).",

[... middle omitted — see footer ...]

    "Regulatory compliance is on the developer per jurisdiction; TFH can take down an app shown to users in a non-compliant jurisdiction — geo-gating is your job (https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/guidelines/policy).",
    "WLD geography restrictions bleed into payouts: WLD (and therefore WLD-denominated dev rewards) excludes certain territories — historically US-wide, then after the May 1, 2025 US relaunch New York plus 'other restricted territories' remain excluded; verify your and your users' eligibility before choosing WLD revenue (https://world.org/not-available, https://world.org/blog/announcements/at-last-trust-in-the-age-of-ai).",
    "Biometric/Orb regulatory hot zones: Orb verification is banned or restricted in Kenya, Hong Kong, South Korea (fine + pause), Indonesia (TDPSE suspension 2025); Philippines NPC issued a cease-and-desist Sept 23, 2025 and Thailand's PDPC banned iris scans Nov 24, 2025 ordering deletion of 1.2M scans — users there may have no or degraded World ID access (https://news.dextools.io/article/what-is-world-chain-worldcoin-l2-guide-2026, https://docs.barcoder.ai/docs/wallets/world-app).",
    "The chain is open everywhere, but your addressable market = Orb/World ID availability; restricted markets dilute the one-human-one-account value prop (https://news.dextools.io/article/what-is-world-chain-worldcoin-l2-guide-2026).",
    "Apple/Google marketplace risk compounds: App/Play store violations by a mini app can be treated as World App's violation, so TFH actively polices mini apps against marketplace policies too (https://aurum.law/newsroom/World-Mini-Apps-2026-The-Legal-and-Compliance-Guide-for-Developers).",
    "Smart-contract upgradeability is restricted (only parameters like protocol fees), contracts must be whitelisted before submission, and fiat paths expose you to chargebacks and full refund/dispute duty (https://strapi.aurum.law/uploads/World_Mini_Apps_Developer_Legal_Guidelines_2026_d55dbc64a1.pdf, https://github.com/ElliotFriedman/harvest-world/blob/main/docs/infra-checklist.md).",
    "Economic caveat: Dev Rewards was a pilot window (through Dec 31, 2025) and rewards are usage-based in WLD with shrinking token prices — don't build the business plan on the $100K/week pool without confirming the current program (UNVERIFIED status) (https://world.org/blog/announcements/dev-rewards-pilot-increases-to-100k-per-week-as-the-world-ecosystem-surpasses-500-mini-apps, https://docs.world.org/mini-apps/more/community-tools-perks).",
    "Quality bar is high vs long tail: flagship apps are VC-funded teams (Kalshi, Morpho, Credit); a hobby-quality clone won't rank — retention/verified-usage is the scoreboard for both users and rewards (https://news.dextools.io/article/what-is-world-chain-worldcoin-l2-guide-2026)."
  ]
worldid_web_adoption:
worldid_web_adoption": "Sign-in / 'human-first web' adoption is broad but mostly integration-standard, not marquee partnerships: World ID 2.0 (Dec 2023) shipped community-built integrations for Reddit, Discord, Minecraft, Shopify, Mercado Libre and Telegram (explicitly 'not official endorsements' of World ID), plus existing Okta Auth0 integration, and OIDC/OAuth2 'Sign in with World ID' with PKCE for native apps (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20231213314816/en/Introducing-Worldcoins-World-ID-2.0-Delivers-enhanced-privacy-and-human-centered-digital-access-to-Shopify-Mercado-Libre-Minecraft-Reddit-and-Telegram, https://world.org/blog/announcements/introducing-world-id-2.0). Confirmed named partners today: Razer, Match Group, Okta Auth0 (https://world.org/faqs); official enterprise partnerships are Zoom (World ID for Zoom: 3-way biometric match, in-tile Human Badge, hosts can require Proof of Presence) and Docusign (https://marketplace.zoom.us/apps/sxFFXjFIQMqXcSIfu-k4zQ, https://world.org/world-id). Payhip: NOT confirmed in any source found — treat UNVERIFIED. 2026 direction: the pitch has shifted to agentic web — World ID for Agents with Browserbase, Exa, Okta and Vercel (AgentKit: delegated Proof of Human, human-in-the-loop verifiable intent; April 17, 2026), World ID for banking & finance unveiled at Money20/20 with Bain Capital, OpenExchange, Outtake, Pantera and VanEck as design partners (Proof of Human / Presence / Attributes; NYSE Orb; Oct 18, 2026), peaqOS bringing World ID to the machine economy (Sept 30, 2026), and Trusted Agent Delegation coalition with Cloudflare announced Nov 12, 2026 covering rate limiting without user identifiers (MoLE) and Web Bot Auth-style signing (https://world.org/blog/announcements/browserbase-exa-okta-world-id-for-agentic-web, https://world.org/blog/announcements/world-id-banking-finance-ai-safe, https://world.org/blog/announcements/trusted-agent-delegation-cloudflare-world). Scale: 18M+ Proof-of-Human holders (banking blog) / 38.3M app users incl. 17.8M verified as of Feb 2026 (aurum guide); World ID app live in 150+ countries. Chain-level human infra: free gas allowance + priority blockspace for verified humans, sybil resistance per-app (https://docs.world.org/world-chain).",
